results.name: Reports from Torture Bench and conversations
Security: hostile challenge links are rejected or neutralised (bad language codes, HTML in names, huge lists)
QA panel: any pair / topic / level / single question; IDs shown; progress kept separate from the normal app
Monetization simulation (QA): locked level → simulated purchase; 3 corrections/day + ad refill; 3 hints/day + ad; ad after 10 questions; Premium removes limits
Rewarded ads (QA simulation): success gives the reward once; cancel/failure/error give nothing; double callbacks cannot duplicate rewards
Corrections after an ad refill behave exactly like before the refill (counter, mistake list, question count)
Lifetime Premium removes the daily correction, hint and continue limits and opens every level
Normal build never shows ads, purchase dialogs or locks from the commercial model
Offline: after the first visit the app and all language data work with no network
Service worker deletes only its own old caches — other Adeba Studio apps and the QA build are untouched
"Force fresh reload" (crash screen) clears only RoastED caches and its own service worker
Update: a new deployment is picked up automatically and the app reloads only on a safe screen
Interrupted download: if a file fails while installing an update, the working version stays and the update retries later
Install metadata: manifest, icons and service worker valid for both builds
Layouts: no sideways scrolling on small/large phones, tablet and landscape (main screens)
Accessibility basics: every button has a name, images have alt text, page language set, top-bar targets ≥ 38 px
Interruptions: app goes to background and back mid-quiz; state kept, no errors
No text-to-speech available: listen buttons show a message, nothing crashes
Voices missing for a language (e.g. Afrikaans) and iPhone speech workaround: speech still requested, no crash
Microphone: not supported / permission denied / no speech — clear messages; short-word message after 2 misses
